description: This file defines the SNSingletonManager class, which manages singleton items within a data synchronization system. It handles ensuring only one item of a certain type exists, resolving conflicts based on strategies, and creating items if they do not exist.

classes.name: SNSingletonManager
classes.description: A class that manages singleton items, ensuring only one item of a certain predicate exists, handling conflicts, and creating items as needed.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources, observers, and references when the manager is deinitialized.

methods.name: popResolveQueue
methods.description: Returns and clears the current resolve queue of items.

methods.name: addObservers
methods.description: Sets up observers for item and sync events to trigger singleton resolution.

methods.name: validItemsMatchingPredicate
methods.description: Filters items matching a specific predicate and content type.

methods.name: resolveSingletonsForItems
methods.description: Resolves singleton conflicts among a list of items based on their strategies after a sync event.

methods.name: handleStrategy
methods.description: Handles conflict resolution strategies, such as keeping the earliest item.

methods.name: findSingleton
methods.description: Finds an existing singleton item matching a predicate.

methods.name: findOrCreateContentTypeSingleton
methods.description: Finds or creates a singleton item of a specific content type, handling synchronization and error states.
